latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Cisco device health check and triage skill.

- Provides structured procedures for assessing Cisco IOS-XE and NX-OS device health, covering routers, switches, and Nexus platforms.
- Includes platform-specific commands, decision trees, and severity thresholds for CPU, memory, interface, routing, and environmental health.
- Supports QFP/RP architecture on IOS-XE and VDC isolation on NX-OS.
- Outputs prioritized findings reports with recommended actions.
- Designed for audit, troubleshooting, post-upgrade checks, incident response, and capacity planning.
